summary: Require every guarded change to discover and acknowledge reverse dependencies, existing tests, related docs/contracts and candidate audit findings, and require real-browser Playwright E2E for browser-impacting changes.

impactAnalysis.notes: This governance change strengthens acceptance criteria and adds a real Chromium E2E harness; runtime product behavior is intentionally unchanged. Existing gate tests, CI wiring, developer entrypoint docs, canonical governance documents and historical audit/closure records that reference the gate are explicitly reviewed. The baseline browser smoke proves stand creation through the real UI. Future browser-impacting changes must name their own targeted E2E spec in addition to the baseline suite.

e2e.reason: This governance change introduces the Playwright browser gate itself, so the harness must be proven by a real user-flow smoke test even though product runtime domains are not changed.

risk.notes: The gate intentionally becomes stricter and CI now installs/runs Chromium. Incomplete impact declarations or missing browser coverage will block changes; runtime application behavior is unchanged.

migration.notes: No product or persisted-data migration is required. Future change declarations use schemaVersion 2, include full-system impactAnalysis, and declare tests.e2e.

rollback: Revert the full-system impact sweep and Playwright governance commits to restore the previous path/domain-only change verification and unit/build-only CI.
